stem: Demand for HDMI cables is inelastic at today's price, with an elasticity of -0.3. A manager plans to raise the price every month, since each rise has lifted revenue. What is wrong with the plan?

options.text: Nothing: with inelastic demand every rise lifts revenue, however high the price
Elasticity changes as the price rises, and customers and rivals react
Inelastic demand means a price rise lowers revenue
An elasticity of -0.3 means units fall 30% for each 1% rise
